summary: A map with flying camera, clusters, animated pins and routes — no API key, works in Expo Go.

behavior: One finger drags and flings with momentum; two fingers pinch around their midpoint and pan at the same time. Double-tap zooms in where you tap, a two-finger tap zooms out, press and hold fires onLongPress.
flyTo zooms out, travels and zooms back in for far hops and glides for near ones; easeTo always glides; fitBounds frames a set of points inside contentInset, so nothing hides under your sheet.

Sharp tiles fade in over a coarser layer two zooms out, so the map is never blank while loading. Tiles are only re-laid-out when the camera drifts far from them; every frame in between is a single transform on the UI thread.
Any view inside MapMarker stays the same size as you zoom. Give it a new coordinate and it glides there; give it a rotation and it turns the short way round. Pins drop in, tags and bubbles grow in.

Esri's keyless light / dark canvas (with a separate label layer), streets and satellite tiles; auto follows the kit's light / dark mode. They're for building and demos: for production traffic pass tileUrl for a provider you have a plan with, and keep the credit line it asks for.
Markers and cluster bubbles are buttons named by their label; the controls are named Zoom in, Zoom out and Show my location.
Camera moves, zooms and route drawing jump to their end; the location pulse stops.
